sourceTitle: The Surrender of Calais: A Play, in Three Acts
description: "The Surrender of Calais: A Play, in Three Acts" by George Colman is a historical play written in 1791. Set during the Siege of Calais in 1346-47, this work blends tragedy and comedy against the backdrop of Edward III's campaign during the Hundred Years War.
